## Enumerations

**`ChainKind`**: AGING_CHAIN.kind  
`0` CARRY8, `1` LUT, `2` INFERRED, `3` REFERENCE

**`SweepMode`**: How the sensor sweeps: off, continuously (about 9000 sweeps per 1 s window), or one sweep per window (as in SBCCI 2026)  
`0` OFF, `1` CONTINUOUS, `2` SINGLE

## Bit fields

**`AgingFlags`**: AGING_WINDOW.flags  
bit 0 NO_ALARM, bit 1 PS_TIMEOUT, bit 2 STUCK, bit 3 LOCK_LOST, bit 4 MEASURE_WINDOW, bit 5 PARTIAL
